BEGIN

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schema_registry" (
		schema_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
		schema_id SMALLINT UNIQUE NOT NULL
	)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entity_main" (
		ltbase_schema_id   SMALLINT NOT NULL,
		ltbase_row_id      UUID NOT NULL,
		text_01            TEXT,
		text_02            TEXT,
		text_03            TEXT,
		text_04            TEXT,
		text_05            TEXT,
		text_06            TEXT,
		text_07            TEXT,
		text_08            TEXT,
		text_09            TEXT,
		text_10            TEXT,
		smallint_01        SMALLINT,
		smallint_02        SMALLINT,
		smallint_03        SMALLINT,
		integer_01         INTEGER,
		integer_02         INTEGER,
		integer_03         INTEGER,
		bigint_01          BIGINT,
		bigint_02          BIGINT,
		bigint_03          BIGINT,
		double_01          DOUBLE PRECISION,
		double_02          DOUBLE PRECISION,
		double_03          DOUBLE PRECISION,
		uuid_01            UUID,
		uuid_02            UUID,
		ltbase_created_at  BIGINT NOT NULL,
		ltbase_updated_at  BIGINT NOT NULL,
		ltbase_deleted_at  BIGINT,
		ltbase_created_by  TEXT,
		ltbase_updated_by  TEXT,
		ltbase_deleted_by  TEXT,
		PRIMARY KEY (ltbase_schema_id, ltbase_row_id)
	)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "eav_data" (
		schema_id      SMALLINT NOT NULL,
		row_id         UUID NOT NULL,
		attr_id        SMALLINT NOT NULL,
		array_indices  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		value_text     TEXT,
		value_numeric  NUMERIC,
		PRIMARY KEY (schema_id, row_id, attr_id, array_indices)
	)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "change_log" (
		    schema_id  SMALLINT NOT NULL,
			row_id     UUID     NOT NULL,
			flushed_at BIGINT   NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			changed_at BIGINT   NOT NULL,
			deleted_at BIGINT,
			primary key (schema_id, row_id, flushed_at)
		)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entity_main_unique_key" (
		ltbase_schema_id SMALLINT NOT NULL,
		key_id           SMALLINT NOT NULL,
		key_value        TEXT     NOT NULL,
		ltbase_row_id    UUID     NOT NULL,
		PRIMARY KEY (ltbase_schema_id, key_id, key_value)
	)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entity_main_unique_key_state" (
		ltbase_schema_id SMALLINT NOT NULL,
		key_id           SMALLINT NOT NULL,
		attributes_hash  TEXT     NOT NULL,
		storage_hash     TEXT     NOT NULL,
		built_at         BIGINT   NOT NULL,
		PRIMARY KEY (ltbase_schema_id, key_id)
	)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entity_main_row_guard" (
		ltbase_schema_id SMALLINT NOT NULL,
		ltbase_row_id    UUID     NOT NULL,
		generation       BIGINT   NOT NULL,
		PRIMARY KEY (ltbase_schema_id, ltbase_row_id)
	)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entity_main_schema_lease" (
		schema_id  SMALLINT NOT NULL,
		holder     UUID     NOT NULL,
		expires_at BIGINT   NOT NULL,
		PRIMARY KEY (schema_id)
	)
ALTER TABLE "schema_registry" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS active_generation BIGINT

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schema_registry_generation" (
		schema_id    SMALLINT NOT NULL,
		generation   BIGINT   NOT NULL,
		content_hash TEXT     NOT NULL,
		recorded_by  TEXT     NOT NULL,
		recorded_at  BIGINT   NOT NULL,
		warnings     TEXT     NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		PRIMARY KEY (schema_id, generation)
	)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schema_registry_generation_attr" (
		schema_id   SMALLINT NOT NULL,
		generation  BIGINT   NOT NULL,
		attr_id     SMALLINT NOT NULL,
		attr_name   TEXT     NOT NULL,
		value_type  TEXT     NOT NULL,
		items_type  TEXT     NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		column_name TEXT     NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		encoding    TEXT     NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		retired     BOOLEAN  NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
		PRIMARY KEY (schema_id, generation, attr_id)
	)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "eav_data_numeric_idx" ON "eav_data" (schema_id, attr_id, value_numeric, row_id) WHERE value_numeric IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "eav_data_text_idx" ON "eav_data" (schema_id, attr_id, value_text, row_id) WHERE value_text IS NOT NULL

SELECT n.nspname::text
FROM pg_class c
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
WHERE c.oid = $1::regclass

SELECT c.relname::text,
       i.indisvalid,
       ARRAY(
           SELECT COALESCE(a.attname::text, '')
           FROM unnest(i.indkey::int2[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ord)
           LEFT JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = i.indrelid AND a.attnum = k.attnum
           WHERE k.ord <= i.indnkeyatts
           ORDER BY k.ord
       ) AS columns,
       array_remove(ARRAY[
           CASE WHEN am.amname <> 'btree' THEN am.amname::text || ' access method' END,
           CASE WHEN i.indisunique THEN 'unique' END,
           CASE WHEN i.indpred IS NOT NULL THEN 'partial' END,
           CASE WHEN i.indexprs IS NOT NULL THEN 'expression key' END,
           CASE WHEN i.indnatts > i.indnkeyatts THEN 'INCLUDE columns' END,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM unnest(i.indclass::oid[]) AS k(opclass)
               JOIN pg_opclass o ON o.oid = k.opclass
               WHERE NOT o.opcdefault
           ) THEN 'non-default operator class' END,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM unnest(i.indkey::int2[], i.indcollation::oid[]) AS k(attnum, coll)
               JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = i.indrelid AND a.attnum = k.attnum
               WHERE k.coll IS NOT NULL AND k.coll <> a.attcollation
           ) THEN 'non-default collation' END,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM unnest(i.indoption::int2[]) AS k(opt) WHERE k.opt <> 0
           ) THEN 'DESC or NULLS FIRST ordering' END
       ], NULL) AS deviations,
       COALESCE((SELECT p.pid FROM pg_stat_progress_create_index p WHERE p.index_relid = i.indexrelid LIMIT 1), 0) AS build_pid
FROM pg_index i
JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indexrelid
JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = c.relam
WHERE i.indrelid = $1::regclass

commit
SELECT row_id FROM "change_log" WHERE schema_id = $1 AND flushed_at = 0

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "change_log" WHERE schema_id = $1 AND flushed_at <> 0)
	OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "entity_main" m WHERE m.ltbase_schema_id = $1 AND NOT EXISTS (
		SELECT 1 FROM "change_log" c WHERE c.schema_id = $1 AND c.row_id = m.ltbase_row_id))

SELECT e.schema_id, e.attr_id, e.row_id, e.array_indices, e.value_numeric::text,
  COALESCE(cl.pending, FALSE), COALESCE(cl.last_flushed_at, 0)
FROM "eav_data" AS e
JOIN (VALUES ($1::smallint, $2::smallint, $3::numeric, $4::numeric), ($5::smallint, $6::smallint, $7::numeric, $8::numeric)) AS w(schema_id, attr_id, lo, hi)
  ON e.schema_id = w.schema_id AND e.attr_id = w.attr_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT COALESCE(BOOL_OR(c.flushed_at = 0), FALSE) AS pending,
         COALESCE(MAX(c.flushed_at) FILTER (WHERE c.flushed_at > 0), 0) AS last_flushed_at
  FROM "change_log" AS c
  WHERE c.schema_id = e.schema_id AND c.row_id = e.row_id
) AS cl ON TRUE
WHERE e.value_numeric IS NOT NULL
  AND (e.value_numeric < w.lo OR e.value_numeric > w.hi OR e.value_numeric <> TRUNC(e.value_numeric))
ORDER BY e.schema_id, e.attr_id, e.row_id, e.array_indices

SELECT m.ltbase_schema_id, w.attr_id, m.ltbase_row_id, v.image, v.exact,
  COALESCE(cl.pending, FALSE), COALESCE(cl.last_flushed_at, 0)
FROM "entity_main" AS m
JOIN (VALUES ($1::smallint, $2::smallint, $3::text, $4::bigint, $5::bigint), ($6::smallint, $7::smallint, $8::text, $9::bigint, $10::bigint)) AS w(schema_id, attr_id, col, lo, hi)
  ON m.ltbase_schema_id = w.schema_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE w.col WHEN 'double_01' THEN m."double_01" WHEN 'double_02' THEN m."double_02" WHEN 'double_03' THEN m."double_03" END AS image, CASE w.col WHEN 'integer_01' THEN m."integer_01"::bigint WHEN 'integer_02' THEN m."integer_02"::bigint WHEN 'integer_03' THEN m."integer_03"::bigint WHEN 'bigint_01' THEN m."bigint_01"::bigint WHEN 'bigint_02' THEN m."bigint_02"::bigint WHEN 'bigint_03' THEN m."bigint_03"::bigint END AS exact) AS v
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT COALESCE(BOOL_OR(c.flushed_at = 0), FALSE) AS pending,
         COALESCE(MAX(c.flushed_at) FILTER (WHERE c.flushed_at > 0), 0) AS last_flushed_at
  FROM "change_log" AS c
  WHERE c.schema_id = m.ltbase_schema_id AND c.row_id = m.ltbase_row_id
) AS cl ON TRUE
WHERE (v.image IS NOT NULL AND (v.image < w.lo::float8 OR v.image > w.hi::float8 OR v.image <> TRUNC(v.image)))
   OR (v.exact IS NOT NULL AND (v.exact < w.lo OR v.exact > w.hi))
ORDER BY m.ltbase_schema_id, w.attr_id, m.ltbase_row_id

SELECT e.schema_id, e.attr_id, e.row_id, e.array_indices, e.value_numeric::text,
  COALESCE(cl.pending, FALSE), COALESCE(cl.last_flushed_at, 0)
FROM "eav_data" AS e
JOIN (VALUES ($1::smallint, $2::smallint), ($3::smallint, $4::smallint)) AS w(schema_id, attr_id)
  ON e.schema_id = w.schema_id AND e.attr_id = w.attr_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT COALESCE(BOOL_OR(c.flushed_at = 0), FALSE) AS pending,
         COALESCE(MAX(c.flushed_at) FILTER (WHERE c.flushed_at > 0), 0) AS last_flushed_at
  FROM "change_log" AS c
  WHERE c.schema_id = e.schema_id AND c.row_id = e.row_id
) AS cl ON TRUE
WHERE e.value_numeric IS NOT NULL
  AND abs(e.value_numeric) >= $5::numeric
ORDER BY e.schema_id, e.attr_id, e.row_id, e.array_indices

SELECT m.ltbase_schema_id, w.attr_id, m.ltbase_row_id, v.image, NULL::bigint,
  COALESCE(cl.pending, FALSE), COALESCE(cl.last_flushed_at, 0)
FROM "entity_main" AS m
JOIN (VALUES ($1::smallint, $2::smallint, $3::text), ($4::smallint, $5::smallint, $6::text)) AS w(schema_id, attr_id, col)
  ON m.ltbase_schema_id = w.schema_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE w.col WHEN 'double_01' THEN m."double_01" WHEN 'double_02' THEN m."double_02" WHEN 'double_03' THEN m."double_03" END AS image) AS v
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT COALESCE(BOOL_OR(c.flushed_at = 0), FALSE) AS pending,
         COALESCE(MAX(c.flushed_at) FILTER (WHERE c.flushed_at > 0), 0) AS last_flushed_at
  FROM "change_log" AS c
  WHERE c.schema_id = m.ltbase_schema_id AND c.row_id = m.ltbase_row_id
) AS cl ON TRUE
WHERE v.image IN ('NaN'::float8, 'Infinity'::float8, '-Infinity'::float8)
ORDER BY m.ltbase_schema_id, w.attr_id, m.ltbase_row_id

SELECT e.schema_id, e.attr_id, e.row_id, e.array_indices, e.value_text, e.value_numeric::text,
  COALESCE(cl.pending, FALSE), COALESCE(cl.last_flushed_at, 0)
FROM "eav_data" AS e
JOIN (VALUES ($1::smallint, $2::smallint, $3::text), ($4::smallint, $5::smallint, $6::text)) AS w(schema_id, attr_id, declared)
  ON e.schema_id = w.schema_id AND e.attr_id = w.attr_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT COALESCE(BOOL_OR(c.flushed_at = 0), FALSE) AS pending,
         COALESCE(MAX(c.flushed_at) FILTER (WHERE c.flushed_at > 0), 0) AS last_flushed_at
  FROM "change_log" AS c
  WHERE c.schema_id = e.schema_id AND c.row_id = e.row_id
) AS cl ON TRUE
WHERE (CASE WHEN w.declared IN ('text', 'uuid') THEN e.value_numeric IS NOT NULL ELSE e.value_text IS NOT NULL END)
   OR (w.declared = 'uuid' AND e.value_text !~ $7)
   OR (w.declared = 'bool' AND abs(e.value_numeric) >= $8::numeric)
   OR (w.declared IN ('date', 'datetime') AND (e.value_numeric <> trunc(e.value_numeric) OR abs(e.value_numeric) > 9007199254740992))
ORDER BY e.schema_id, e.attr_id, e.row_id, e.array_indices

SELECT m.ltbase_schema_id, w.attr_id, m.ltbase_row_id, v.image,
  COALESCE(cl.pending, FALSE), COALESCE(cl.last_flushed_at, 0)
FROM "entity_main" AS m
JOIN (VALUES ($1::smallint, $2::smallint, $3::text, $4::text), ($5::smallint, $6::smallint, $7::text, $8::text)) AS w(schema_id, attr_id, col, declared)
  ON m.ltbase_schema_id = w.schema_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE w.col WHEN 'ltbase_created_by' THEN m."ltbase_created_by" WHEN 'ltbase_deleted_by' THEN m."ltbase_deleted_by" WHEN 'ltbase_updated_by' THEN m."ltbase_updated_by" WHEN 'text_01' THEN m."text_01" WHEN 'text_02' THEN m."text_02" WHEN 'text_03' THEN m."text_03" WHEN 'text_04' THEN m."text_04" WHEN 'text_05' THEN m."text_05" WHEN 'text_06' THEN m."text_06" WHEN 'text_07' THEN m."text_07" WHEN 'text_08' THEN m."text_08" WHEN 'text_09' THEN m."text_09" WHEN 'text_10' THEN m."text_10" END AS image) AS v
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT COALESCE(BOOL_OR(c.flushed_at = 0), FALSE) AS pending,
         COALESCE(MAX(c.flushed_at) FILTER (WHERE c.flushed_at > 0), 0) AS last_flushed_at
  FROM "change_log" AS c
  WHERE c.schema_id = m.ltbase_schema_id AND c.row_id = m.ltbase_row_id
) AS cl ON TRUE
WHERE v.image IS NOT NULL AND (w.declared <> 'bool' OR v.image NOT IN ('1', '0'))
ORDER BY m.ltbase_schema_id, w.attr_id, m.ltbase_row_id
